business_model.claim: Research Publishing, which has over 1,900 journals, earns revenue from journal subscriptions and transformational agreements under multi-year arrangements, from open access (pay to publish), and from licensing and ancillary products. higher royalty costs which includes higher royalty on AI license revenue from content licensed from other publishers
